name: Site Under Construction
author: BDPlugins

sections.description:
Site Under Construction is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed to help you temporarily hide your website while it is under development, maintenance, or preparing for launch.

Once enabled, visitors will see a clean and modern Coming Soon page, while logged-in administrators can access and manage the site normally. The plugin is easy to configure, performance-friendly, and follows WordPress coding standards.

Whether you are redesigning a website or preparing for a launch, this plugin provides a simple and reliable solution.

Features

  • Enable or disable Coming Soon mode with a single click
  • Customizable page title, heading, and description text
  • Choose from 4 modern Coming Soon templates
  • Optional password protection for visitor access
  • Administrators automatically bypass the Coming Soon page
  • Simple settings page under the WordPress Tools menu
  • Lightweight, fast, and compatible with modern WordPress versions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
    OR install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Coming Soon.
  4. Enable Coming Soon mode and customize the page settings.
sections.faq:
Who will see the Coming Soon page?

All visitors who are not logged in as administrators will see the Coming Soon page. Administrators can access the website normally.

Can I customize the Coming Soon content?

Yes. You can customize the page title, heading, description text, and select a template from the plugin settings.

Does the plugin support password protection?

Yes. You can enable password protection to allow visitors to access the site using a password while Coming Soon mode is active.

How do I disable Coming Soon mode?

Simply uncheck the Enable Coming Soon Mode option from the plugin settings page and save your changes.
